import numpy as np

def kernel(q, k, v, w):
    """Windowed attention: position i attends to [i-w, i+w] only."""
    n = q.shape[0]
    tile_size_rows = 128
    tile_size_cols = 512

    # Split the indices into tiles
    row_tiles = np.arange(0, n, tile_size_rows)
    col_tiles = np.arange(0, n, tile_size_cols)

    result = np.zeros_like(q, dtype=q.dtype)

    for i in row_tiles:
        for j in col_tiles:
            # Extract tile from q, k, v
            q_tile = q[i:i+tile_size_rows]
            k_tile = k[j:j+tile_size_cols]
            v_tile = v[j:j+tile_size_cols]

            # Compute attention scores
            qd = q_tile.astype(np.float64)
            kd = k_tile.astype(np.float64)
            vd = v_tile.astype(np.float64)

            s = qd @ kd.T / np.sqrt(q_tile.shape[1])
            idx = np.arange(q_tile.shape[0])
            band = np.abs(idx[:, None] - idx[None, :]) <= w
            s = np.where(band, s, -np.inf)

            # Compute softmax
            m = s.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            e = np.exp(s - m)
            e = e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)

            # Apply attention to value
            result[i:i+tile_size_rows] = (e @ vd).astype(q.dtype)

    return result
